scope: Shared conformance vectors for admitted fixed health projection; native acceptance remains separate.
input_encoding: UTF-8 JSON bytes of input_utf8. Preserve duplicate keys inside strings for parser controls.

cases.name: complete-current-generation
cases.rule: Four current known facts; recovery classification is not an exact fault cause. Producer implementation identity remains unknown.

cases.name: rotated-or-dropped-summary
cases.rule: No guessing another boot or a lost-line count.

cases.name: boot-identity-refusal
cases.rule: Ticks remain a local sample; no recovery join without epoch.

cases.name: exact-large-integers
cases.rule: Decimal strings retain precision beyond binary64 integer exactness.

cases.name: explicit-existing-channel-denial
cases.rule: Use denied only when the source actually refuses authority; not for a transport timeout.

cases.name: unknown-version
cases.rule: Unknown semantic version.

cases.name: missing-fact
cases.rule: Fixed four-fact profile.

cases.name: duplicate-fact
cases.rule: No duplicate IDs even with identical values.

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.rule: Closed draft profile; labels grant no authority.

cases.name: wrong-owner
cases.rule: Recovery source is FSD, not a kernel fact.

cases.name: wrong-source
cases.rule: Fact/source correspondence is fixed.

cases.name: known-with-refusal
cases.rule: Known requires null reason.

cases.name: unavailable-with-value
cases.rule: Unavailable requires null value.

cases.name: false-complete-summary
cases.rule: Unavailable fact requires partial status.

cases.name: numeric-counter
cases.rule: Counters are strings, never JSON numeric values.

cases.name: overflow-u64
cases.rule: No u64 overflow.

cases.name: leading-zero-counter
cases.rule: Canonical unsigned decimal string.

cases.name: negative-counter
cases.rule: Unsigned counter.

cases.name: rewound-interval
cases.rule: No fabricated acquisition ordering.

cases.name: previous-boot-summary
cases.rule: Recovery boot must equal acquired epoch.

cases.name: boot-fact-mismatch
cases.rule: Boot fact must equal context epoch.

cases.name: unjustified-history-loss-zero
cases.rule: Log projection has unknown historical loss, not no-history semantics.

cases.name: unknown-reason
cases.rule: Closed bounded reason vocabulary.

cases.name: oversized-string
cases.rule: At most 128 encoded bytes per ordinary string.

cases.name: duplicate-json-key
cases.rule: Duplicate object keys are refused before last-key-wins decoding.

cases.name: oversized-document
cases.rule: At most 8192 input bytes, independent of semantic content.

cases.name: historical-record-is-not-current-instant
cases.rule: Recovery freshness describes a boot-matched recorded summary, not a live point sample.

cases.name: generation-reference-mismatch
cases.rule: The recorded lifetime reference must agree with the recovery payload sequence.

cases.name: fsd-absent
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-timeout
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-unsupported
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-denied
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-malformed
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-protocol
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: version-release
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: recovery-malformed
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: rotated-io-error
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: rotated-permission
cases.rule: Explicit source refusal; no inferred known value or denial.

cases.name: malformed-timeout-pair
cases.rule: Per-fact availability/reason mapping and boot-context correspondence; producer cannot emit this pair.

cases.name: unavailable-malformed-recovery-pair
cases.rule: Per-fact availability/reason mapping and boot-context correspondence; producer cannot emit this pair.

cases.name: known-boot-with-boot-unavailable-reason
cases.rule: Per-fact availability/reason mapping and boot-context correspondence; producer cannot emit this pair.

cases.name: unavailable-ticks
cases.rule: Per-fact availability/reason mapping and boot-context correspondence; producer cannot emit this pair.

review_delta: Opus health JSON L2: reject four inconsistent fact/refusal combinations without changing wire version.
